properties.name: app.mail.from
properties.description: Default sender email address for outgoing emails.

properties.name: app.mail.fail-silently
properties.description: Whether to silently ignore email sending failures instead of throwing exceptions.

properties.name: app.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the application, used for generating links in emails.

properties.name: app.security.token-expiration-minutes
properties.description: Expiration time in minutes for authentication tokens.

properties.name: app.admin.email
properties.description: Email address of the default admin account.

properties.name: app.admin.password
properties.description: Password of the default admin account.

properties.name: app.routing.api-key
properties.description: API key for the routing service (OpenRouteService).

properties.name: app.routing.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the routing service API.

properties.name: app.routing.timeout-ms
properties.description: Timeout in milliseconds for routing service HTTP requests.

properties.name: app.routing.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of requests per minute allowed to the routing service.

properties.name: app.routing.cache-seconds
properties.description: Cache duration in seconds for routing service responses.
